description:
List batch calling campaigns

Returns the account's outbound campaigns, newest first. Query parameters are validated strictly: an unrecognised `status`, or a `perPage` above 100, is rejected with 400 rather than quietly clamped, which is different from the paging behaviour elsewhere in this API. The `pagination` block echoes the applied page and page size and carries `total`, a real count of the campaigns matching the same `status` filter as the page. Reading campaigns uses the `read:agents` scope rather than a scope of its own.

page.description: Page to return, starting at 1. Defaults to 1. A value below 1 is rejected with 400, not clamped.

perPage.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20. A value outside that range is rejected with 400, not clamped.

status.description: Return only campaigns in this state. Any other value is rejected with 400.

name: list_call_campaigns
title: List batch calling campaigns
